title: Cisco Nexus 3000 Series NX-OS Release Notes, Release 10.2(6)M

observations.description: Crash in the ptplc process Symptoms: System reloads after the ptplc process crashes. It will leave a core file similar to the following: Nexus# show cores VDC Module Instance Process-name PID Date(Year-Month-Day Time) --- ------ -------- --------------- -------- ------------------------- 1 1 1 ptplc 7879 2023-08-04 14:03:21 1 1 1 ptplc 19500 2023-08-04 14:03:30 Workarounds: None
N3548-XL does not show SPAN drops Symptoms: Missing SPAN packet copies. Workarounds: None

N3500 shows incorrect next-hop in routing hash cli output Symptoms: N3500 running 10.3.3 version of nxos shows incorrect next-hop in 'show routing hash’ cli output when egress interface is SVI and there are 2 next-hops in associated vlan to reach destination subnet. Workarounds: None

Nexus 3548: L3 Adjacency is not programmed properly in hardware Symptoms: L3 adjacency is mis-programed in HW and routed packets to destination hosts are dropped. Issue might happen for single or multiple hosts. Workarounds: Running 'clear ip arp force-delete' for the affected entries triggers ARP learning again and HW entry is refreshed. Doing 'clear ip arp force-delete' for an entire subnet/VLAN might cause a couple of seconds of disruption.

Nexus 3000 Spanning-tree create instance for interface that is a part of a port-channel Symptoms: - Spanning will create instance on interface that is a part of a port-channel- This will cause STP disputes on the root bridge. Workarounds: Use "channel-group" without force option i.e., Configure MTU explicitly on Eth1/43 before running 'channel-group'.

N3500 fails to program SG L3 ltl-index after receving igmpv3 source leave on mrouter port Symptoms: After mcast flow stop fzor about 3 minutes, l3-ltl will age on mtc, then start the mcast flow again, l3-ltl will never program. Workarounds: None

Nexus 3548 not acknowledging link up/down events. Symptoms: Once link is flapped, it remains in Link not connected state.Although we are receiving proper signal from other side and Good-2-bad and bad-2-good interrupts are getting generated, those are not getting asserted. Workarounds: Use the following commands: #attach mod 1module 1 #test hardware internal mtc-usd gpe 5 disablemodule 1 #test hardware internal mtc-usd gpe 5 enable

Cisco Nexus 3000 switch (4GB) reloads with Kernel panic and no core. Symptoms: Cisco Nexus 3000 switches with 4GB RAM that run SNMP on Cisco NX-OS Releases lower than 9.3(9) or 10.2(6), frequently reload with kernel panic. There is no core getting generated due to low memory in the box. Device reports critical memory alert followed by reload due to kernel panic. Workarounds: None

Unexpected reload ipfib hap reset Symptoms: Unexpected reload on N3K System version: 9.3(10). ERSPAN was configured about 4 minutes before the device crashed. FIB functions were cycled recursively generating more than 4000 functions in the backtrace and system crashed. Last reload reason: Last reset at 435377 usecs after Thu Jun 22 10:26:36 2023 Reason: Reset Requested due to Fatal Module Error System version: 9.3(10) Service: ipfib hap reset Workarounds: None

N3548 does not display all SPAN sessions in SPAN drop output Symptoms: N3548 does not display all SOAN sessions in 'show monitor session all drop' cli output Workarounds: Use 'show monitor session X drop' for each SPAN session.
